meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 机器人通道：从 channels 分支复制 Discord 适配器、注册并安装指定版本依赖，再引导你创建 Discord 机器人、粘贴 Bot Token，重启服务后即可在 Discord 私信或服务器频道里对话。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 时使用——在 /setup 流程中，或直接要求添加 Discord 通道。机器人必须与你在同一个服务器，才能给你发私信。

say.text: 把 Discord 机器人加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖，并让你贴 Bot Token

say.text: 机器人建好了，Bot Token 是这串：<token>
say.note: 校验通过后自动推导 App ID 和公钥

say.text: 重启服务，让 Discord 通道生效
say.note: 重启后就能在私信里和它对话

howto.what_en: Adds a Discord channel to NanoClaw: copies the Discord adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, then guides you through creating a bot, pasting its token, and restarting the service to chat by DM or channel.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw on Discord — during /setup or when you ask to add a Discord channel. The bot must share a server with you before it can DM you.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, asks for your token

say_en.text: I created the bot — here is the Bot Token: <token>
say_en.note: Validates it and derives the App ID and public key

say_en.text: Restart the service so the Discord channel works
say_en.note: After the restart you can chat with it by DM
